obligation: forward realization / real-slice admission before state-effect readout
retained_source: Read the complete seven-primitive base_gram table and the original p/k, edge-momentum and edge-reference definitions. The four-momentum principal restriction is a necessary condition on the full source, not a replacement source.

target_type: Real momenta in R^(1,3), with eta=diag(1,-1,-1,-1); physical helicity polarizations may be complex
conjecture: For real a!=0 the source momentum block has inertia (2,2), so it has no label-preserving real Lorentzian realization. Ward identities and formal closure do not by themselves supply positive physical phase-space pairing.
rivals: a reference or incoming/outgoing sign convention repairs the real realization
